facts.text: Canterbury Christ Church University started out as a teacher training college in the 1960s in response to a national shortage of teachers.

sources.title: Guide to applying for international students - Canterbury Christ Church University
topics: why you have applied to study with CCCU
quotes: Why would you like to study in the UK and, more specifically, here at Canterbury Christ Church University?
sources.notes: WebFetch returned only navigation/headers (page is JS-rendered; a curl of the page yielded 108 characters of text), so the quote and process description come from the search-result summary, which said: 'If your application requires a pre-CAS interview, you will be invited by the Admissions team, with your email invitation containing all the instructions you need to access your interview and prepare'; 'The interview is the university's opportunity to get to know you and why you have applied to study with them'; 'Once complete, the Admissions team will contact you to let you know if you have been successful and send you further information on your CAS and the VISA application process.' Attribution of the quote to this exact URL (rather than https://www.canterbury.ac.uk/study-here/applying/how-to-prepare-for-an-interview) is inferred from the search summary and should be re-verified in a browser.

sources.title: Canterbury Christ Church University: live CAS Shield tenant (canterbury.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.
